beliefs: The box reverses the first whitespace-separated word [E1, E4, E5]
The box reverses the concatenation of all remaining words (joined without spaces) [E3, E5: 'abc def ghi'->'cba ihgfed', 'abc def ghi jkl'->'cba lkjihgfed']
Whitespace runs collapse to a single space and leading/trailing whitespace is stripped [E2, E3]
Empty or all-whitespace input maps to empty string [E1, E2]
Case and symbols are preserved within each reversed chunk [E1, E3, E4]
Punctuation attached to a word stays attached and is reversed with the word [E3, E4]
When there is only one word, output is just that word reversed [E1, E4]
notes: Fixed the rule: first word reversed, then the rest concatenated (no spaces) and reversed, joined by one space. This explains 'abc def ghi'->'cba ihgfed' and 'a1 b2 c3'->'1a 3c2b'. Removed the dedup guess which was wrong.
